 Riemer again leaves Froholdt on bench for Portugal-clash: See the Danish starting lineup 
 Riemer again leaves Froholdt on bench for Portugal-clash: See the Danish starting lineup
 Svend Bertil Frandsen Victor Froholdt has again been left on the bench Credit: ČTK / AP / Ulrik Pedersen Danish national team coach Brian Riemer has opted not to start FC Porto's Victor Froholdt in the Nations League clash against Portugal , while Mohamed Daramy once again features in the starting lineup on the left wing. In goal, Riemer has put his faith in Mads Hermansen.
 Mohamed Daramy and Alexander Bah will start for Denmark in the away match against Portugal .
 National team coach Brian Riemer has included Daramy on the left side of the attack following several strong performances during the most recent international break.
 With Daramy in the starting lineup, Mikkel Damsgaard has been moved into an attacking midfield role. Victor Froholdt begins the match on the bench.
 Mads Hermansen has been selected to start in goal ahead of Filip Jorgensen. Having also played in Denmark’s last two matches, this marks the third consecutive start for the West Ham goalkeeper.
 Bah gets the nod at right-back, replacing Rasmus Nissen Kristensen—who is one of five players at risk of suspension for Tuesday’s match against Norway should he receive a yellow card.
 Additionally, Joakim Maehle, Gustav Isaksen, Daramy, and Hermansen also face suspension if they are cautioned. All four are in the starting lineup, indicating that Riemer has not factored the risk of suspension into his selection.
 Riemer traveled to Braga with 24 players; however, as the matchday squad is limited to 23, Albert Gronbaek has been left out and will watch from the stands.
 Denmark will field the following 11 players (4-3-3):
 Mads Hermansen – Alexander Bah, Joachim Andersen, Oliver Provstgaard, Joakim Maehle – Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg, Morten Hjulmand, Mikkel Damsgaard – Gustav Isaksen, Rasmus Hojlund, Mohamed Daramy.
